## Key Insights The safety guard is necessary and must continue rejecting affirmative, ambiguous, or joined-clause attempts to assign lifecycle outcomes. The bounded choice is a small structural negative grammar plus fixtures that prove the reproduced safe case passes and representative positive or ambiguous directives still fail.
